gettingStarted.defs.title: Set up metafield definitions
gettingStarted.defs.description: Create custom.model_3d (file) and custom.viewer_3d_config (JSON) with storefront read access.

gettingStarted.upload.description: Pick a product and upload a .glb file. The block automatically reads it on the storefront.

gettingStarted.block.description: In Online Store → Themes → Customize → Product template, add "3D Viewer — Product" under Apps.
